author: bardic-inspiration
name: Testmore Keep
summary: A ruined hill keep of five rooms, now the cult's hidden temple.
description: Testmore Keep was abandoned after its lord failed every trial the crown set him. The cult chose it for the joke, and stayed for the cellars.

zones.name: Gatehouse
zones.note: The way in, through a portcullis rusted half open.

zones.name: Shrine of Seals
zones.note: Five stone seals set in the floor, each carved with a different sigil.

zones.name: Fallen Armory
zones.note: Half the ceiling lies on the weapon racks.

zones.name: Ritual Chamber
zones.note: A ring of candles around a lectern holding an enormous ledger.

zones.name: Vault
zones.note: A locked strongroom behind the lectern.
